implemented.name: Query Clusters (Honua extension)
implemented.notes: DBSCAN or K-Means clustering. algorithm defaults to 'dbscan' when omitted. eps is meters (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxDbscanEpsMeters); algorithm-specific required parameters are validated. returnHullPerCluster=true returns one feature per cluster (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxClusters) with clusterId and featureCount; default returns one row per source feature with objectId, nested attributes, geometry, and clusterId. outStatistics requires returnHullPerCluster=true; per-feature cluster assignments cannot carry aggregate columns and return HTTP 400 if both are supplied. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null in per-feature mode, populated in hull mode). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Bounded by Limits.Analytics.MaxInputFeatures. Pro-tier (ADR-0024); Community requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden with a StandardErrorResponse body (mirrors the PrintingTools layout-template gate). Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

implemented.name: Spatial Join (Honua extension)
implemented.notes: Joins target layer against joinLayerId (must differ) using predicate intersects/contains/within/dwithin. dwithin requires positive distance in meters (capped by Limits.Analytics.MaxDWithinDistanceMeters). Each target feature preserves objectId, nested attributes, and geometry while adding matchCount; carryFields is a comma-separated list and is emitted as arrays of matched join-layer values, while outStatistics aggregates over matched rows. The join layer is resolved through the same IResourceValidator access policy as the target. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null for this operation's maxOutputRows). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Pro-tier (ADR-0024); Community requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

implemented.name: Query Buffer Aggregate (Honua extension)
implemented.notes: Buffers each feature by distance in unit (meters/kilometers/feet/miles). The Limits.Analytics.MaxBufferDistanceMeters cap is enforced after unit conversion so it cannot be bypassed by switching to a larger unit. dissolve=true (default) unions overlapping buffers per group via ST_Union and returns dissolved polygons with featureCount plus any group/stat columns; dissolve=false returns one row per input feature with buffered geometry and objectId. groupByFields and outStatistics follow the standard GeoServices statistics shape. outStatistics requires dissolve=true; per-feature output (dissolve=false) cannot carry aggregate columns and returns HTTP 400. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows (null for this operation's maxOutputRows). FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Pro-tier (ADR-0024); Community requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

implemented.name: Query Density (Honua extension)
implemented.notes: Hex or square grid binning over Web Mercator. cellSize is meters and is clamped to [Limits.Analytics.MinDensityCellSizeMeters, Limits.Analytics.MaxDensityCellSizeMeters]. Output rows include cellId and featureCount; optional weightField adds a weighted sum column named weight. Shared filters include where, objectIds, geometry/geometryType/inSR/spatialRel, and time/timeRelation; distance-based esri spatial relationships are rejected because distance is operation-specific on the analytics slice. Returns application/geo+json with WGS84 coordinates, numberReturned = features.length, and metadata.operation/inputTruncated/resultTruncated/maxInputFeatures/maxOutputRows. FeatureServer-style f is accepted for parity but does not change the response media type; unsupported POST content types return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type. Output bounded by Limits.Analytics.MaxDensityCells. Pro-tier (ADR-0024); Community requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden. Deployments without a PostGIS-backed analytics reader (for example the DuckDB read-only provider) return HTTP 501 Not Implemented via TryGetAnalyticsReader.

partial.name: Query
partial.notes: Returns Esri-compatible raster catalog features (OBJECTID, footprint polygon, MinPS/MaxPS/CenterX/CenterY/ZOrder/Shape_Length/Shape_Area/AcquisitionDate). Supports where (parsed via the GeoServices SQL filter parser, applied in-memory; max 2000 chars), objectIds, outSR (envelope-only stamping; geometry is NOT reprojected), resultOffset, resultRecordCount (default 100, capped at 1000), and the returnGeometry/returnIdsOnly/returnCountOnly/returnExtentOnly shaping flags. Spatial WHERE pushdown, outFields projection, orderByFields, time, pixelSize, and arbitrary geometry/spatialRel filters are not yet honoured.

partial.name: Compute Statistics and Histograms
partial.notes: Returns per-band statistics ({min,max,mean,standardDeviation,count}) and per-band histograms ({size,min,max,counts[]}). Supports rasterIds (CSV/JSON array of catalog object IDs; defaults to the layer's primary raster), the Honua-extension bandIds selector (1-based), and histogramParameters.size (default 256, capped at 1024). The parallel statistics[] and histograms[] arrays are aligned positionally: index i on both sides describes the same band. Multiple rasterIds are appended in request order. A band is only dropped from both arrays when neither the statistics nor the histograms result contained an entry for it; when a band is present on only one side, the missing side is zero-filled (an all-zero BandStatistic, or a BandHistogram with empty counts[]) so the parallel arrays stay index-aligned. AOI clipping (geometry/mosaicRule/renderingRule) and pixelSize are accepted as request fields but not yet applied — analysis always covers the full raster.

honuaExtensions.name: Compute Class (raster function chain validator)
honuaExtensions.notes: Closest in spirit to Esri's validate operation. Accepts a raster function chain document via renderingRule (or the legacy rasterFunction alias) and returns the planned execution metadata (rasterFunction, chainDepth, executedFunctions[], outputPixelType, status). The MVP planner walks Identity / Stretch / Clip nodes (max chain depth 8) and rejects unknown functions with a 400; full executor wiring into exportImage / computeStatisticsHistograms is tracked as a follow-on.

Only f=json/f=pjson is accepted.

knownLimitations: PrintingTools GPServer surface (Export Web Map Task, Get Layout Templates Info Task) is implemented via dedicated endpoints.

Generic GPServer adapter (#723) operates over the canonical process runtime. The built-in IProcessCatalog seeds 34 processes across geometry.*, analytics.*, surface.*, raster.*, conversion.*, generalization.*, and data-management.* families for plan validation (#735, #736, #737); heavyweight surface.* and raster.* workloads remain on the canonical worker/executor boundary (optional #727 executor adapters), and destructive data-management ids (delete-features, calculate-field) route through the operator approval gate before execution. Published task names currently mirror those built-in process IDs.
Generic built-in tasks are async-only; a generic synchronous execute route is not published until ExecutePlan and synchronous task projection exist.
Canonical model and lifecycle state mappings are established in #360.
